text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan, Yaeno, thank you so much for<n>today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I still can't believe you threw me a<n>birthday party...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
How could we not, for the birthday of<n>someone so
dear to us? I'm glad you<n>enjoyed it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Do forgive the cake being... well, not<n>very
flavorsome.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes... The western sweets available<n>at stores are
much more sweet, but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Whenever Ardan or I make<n>something from scratch,
it seems to<n>turn out bland...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
N-no, not at all! I could tell you both<n>put a lot of love
into it—really, the cake<n>was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Plus, if we want a sweeter cake, why<n>don't we
make one with the three of<n>us?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well... You are a skilled chef when<n>it comes to all
things sweet, so we<n>might have to take you up on
that<n>offer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Great! As they say, "Two's company,<n>three's for
cake!"

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Yaeno
text_block_list.text: (I think I get it? Or maybe not...)
